description: This file defines the Device entity class for a Java application using JPA. It maps to the 'devices' table in the database and includes fields such as id, name, ipAddress, protocol, description, status, timestamps, and userId, along with constructors, getters, setters, and lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: An entity class representing a device with properties like id, name, ipAddress, protocol, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt, and userId, with associated JPA annotations and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: Device()
methods.description: Default constructor for the Device class.

methods.name: Device(String, String, String, String)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a Device with specific attributes; sets createdAt and updatedAt to current time.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the device's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the device's unique identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the device.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the device's name and updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the device.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Sets the IP address and updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the communication protocol used by the device.

methods.name: setProtocol
methods.description: Sets the communication protocol and updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the device description.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the device description and updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the device.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the device status and updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the device record.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp of the device record.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the device for multi-tenancy.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the device.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: JPA callback invoked before persisting; initializes createdAt and updatedAt to current time.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: JPA callback invoked before updating; updates the updatedAt timestamp to current time.
